checks.name: A normal join: the guest’s character screen survives the host’s household, its choices reach the host, and after moving in the guest takes the host’s household
Eight presses that are never sent leave the guest in step: the host’s next household is taken; the graphics-quality press stays on its own phone

A dropped link: after eight seconds what both did arrives and nobody is told anything was lost; after 45 seconds (the connection dies) the guest’s purchase is kept when the host did nothing meanwhile, and when both acted the host’s stands and the guest is told
Two purchases in the same instant with money for one: the purse is charged once and three seconds later both phones show the same single purchase
Four carries with Build, two by each player: no piece is left in the partner’s hands, none is duplicated, and both phones hold the same flat
Two different pieces put on one cell in the same instant: the host’s stands, the other is back in storage on both phones, and nothing is lost
Both players press the night panel’s only button in the same instant: one day passes, both phones wake to the same market and both keep their morning page
The sofa is carried through the door: it is placed once, at the same moment and with the same words on both phones, and the household is written while the “It is in” panel is still open

both.words: The sofa went in first try. Nobody will believe it.

checks.name: The partner’s page reloads in the middle of the carry: the sofa is set down with a message, the remaining player walks freely, and the reloaded phone finds the sofa where it was left and lifts it again
Both pages close and reopen (the guest first): both players stand where they were, one in the flat and one on Market Road, not at the gate
The phone that held the meeting point sleeps for a minute and a half and wakes: it joins the phone that took over, both see each other, and they hold one household
A third device typing the code while two phones play is turned away and keeps nothing; the starter’s phone, with its storage cleared, joins by code and gets Player 1’s seat back

checks.name: “Start a new household” in the two-phone Menu offers to leave: the household stays as it was on both phones, the partner plays on, and Continue together brings the leaver back
After both phones reopen, opening the album brings both players’ pictures back on both phones; a picture that is not an image data address is not drawn
One player sits on the sofa: only that player is seated, and the partner, with no panel, walks on
What is in each player’s hands is part of the household: a reload, leaving from the Menu, two players taking one piece and a placement lost with the connection neither lose nor duplicate a piece

info.sameInstant: the host’s player holds it; the guest is told
info.lostPlacement: back in the hands, the guest told

checks.name: A third device turned away from a household keeps nothing of it and never shows its world; its own saved household is untouched after Try again and Back
The guest’s walking speed and Bigger text survive the host’s household; the speed reaches the host, the text size stays on the guest’s phone
A night panel left open on a phone that slept while the other pressed it: it closes when the new day arrives, and a press for the past night does nothing; one day passes

The sofa: a phone locked for ten seconds mid-carry and a reload of two seconds leave it set down in one place on both phones; a phone still carrying a sofa the household says is in lets go and can walk; a household from an older build does not move it back to the gate

info.lockedPhone: down on both, in one place
info.olderHost: the guest lets go and walks
info.olderHostSetDown: where it was carried, on both

checks.name: One player swaps the stations as the other answers: the swap does not apply, both stations can be finished and the dish is served on both phones
Deliveries held for three seconds while the host writes: the guest’s purchase never disappears from its bag, arrives at the host, and nobody is told anything was lost
A phone wakes alone after twenty seconds while the host has Build open: both phones hold the same household and the fridge is not duplicated
A picture taken while the partner was away is shown by the phone that holds the meeting point next time; two pictures taken in the same instant are never shown under each other’s caption

What the guest did while it was alone, and that reached the host inside the household the guest wrote, is kept and nobody is told it was lost: a purchase just after the channel is replaced, two purchases while the host’s phone is locked, a table put down between channels

info.channelReplaced: kept on both, nobody told, at 100, 600 and 1000 ms

checks.name: Deliveries held for two seconds and the guest’s link to the meeting service dropping meanwhile: its channel to the host stays, so nothing is taken for lost; both purchases are kept and nobody is told anything
A picture taken on the guest phone while the connection was down is drawn in the other phone’s album once the room has joined again by itself, with no reload
Two players leave a household, play another together, and come back to the first by its code, Player 1 typing it first: each phone is back in its own seat

method: Two or three copies of the shipped game logic in Node, joined through the real room code in dist/src/together-v47.js over a stand-in for PeerJS with one world clock (check/two-phones.cjs). State and replay order only: no browser, no real network, no public PeerJS service, no phone.
